adds.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
adds.text: When the Silver Surfer interrupts Sue's wedding, Johnny chases him and comes back able to swap powers by touch. After Doom impales Sue, Johnny takes the whole team's powers, her invisibility among them, and beats Doom.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Her younger brother. Borrows her invisibility to beat Doom after Doom wounds her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: His older sister. Doom impales her, and Johnny takes her powers to fight back.
adds.evidence: Rise of the Silver Surfer: Reed and Sue's wedding is interrupted, Johnny pursues the Surfer and gains power-swapping by touch; in Shanghai Doom impales Sue, and Johnny absorbs the team's combined powers (using Sue's invisibility to sneak up on Doom) and defeats him.

adds.title: Spider-Man 3
adds.text: Peter learns that Flint Marko, not the man he let escape, shot Ben, and he hunts Marko for revenge. In the end Marko tells him the shooting was an accident, and Peter forgives him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's uncle, whose true killer Peter hunts, then forgives.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Ben's nephew, who hunts Ben's true killer, then forgives him.
adds.evidence: Spider-Man 3: Captain Stacy tells Peter and May that Marko was Ben's true killer and the first suspect only his accomplice; a vengeful Peter fights Marko; after the final battle Marko explains Ben's death was an accident and Peter forgives him. A flashback shows Marko's gun going off when the escaping crook grabs his arm.

adds.title: Spider-Man 2
adds.text: Mary Jane stays friends with Harry after their breakup. When Doctor Octopus kidnaps her as part of Harry's deal to capture Spider-Man, Harry tells Peter where she is held.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Her ex-boyfriend, still a friend. Tells Peter where she is held.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: His ex-girlfriend, still a friend. Kidnapped through his deal with Doctor Octopus.
adds.evidence: Spider-Man 2: Mary Jane maintains her friendships with both Peter and Harry; Harry trades tritium to Octavius for Spider-Man and tells him to use Peter, Octavius kidnaps Mary Jane to coerce Peter, and Harry reluctantly gives Peter Octavius's and Mary Jane's location so he can save her.

adds.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
adds.text: Richard leaves young Peter at May and Ben's home and walks out with only "Be good." Years later May tells Peter that his father was a man on the run whose research was worth a lot of money.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Her brother-in-law. She tells Peter he fled with valuable research.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: His sister-in-law, who tells Peter what she knows of his flight.
adds.evidence: The Amazing Spider-Man 2 opens with Richard at Ben and May's home leaving Peter with them; later May and Peter argue about his parents and she tells him his father was a man on the run whose research was worth a lot of money.

adds.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
adds.text: Before leaving with Richard, Mary goes over last-minute notes about young Peter with May and Ben.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Her sister-in-law. Leaves young Peter with her, with last-minute notes.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Her sister-in-law, who takes young Peter in.
adds.evidence: The Amazing Spider-Man 2 opening flashback: at Ben and May's home, Mary tells Ben and May some last-minute notes about Peter before she and Richard leave.

adds.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
adds.text: Jefferson and Rio celebrate his promotion to police captain, and together they extend Miles's punishment when he runs off with Gwen. When Miles goes missing, Gwen promises them both she will bring him back.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: His wife. Worries with him over Miles.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Her husband, newly promoted to police captain.
adds.evidence: Across the Spider-Verse: Miles is late to the party for his father Jeff's promotion to police captain; after he runs away with Gwen his parents extend his punishment; Gwen later promises Rio and Jeff of Earth-1610 to bring Miles back.

none.title: X-Men '97#19
none.why: In Survival of the Fittest (running #19, S2 ep 9) Rogue's storyline is Eson, Gambit and Apocalypse; Creed appears only in the mid-credits scene being elected president. They never deal with each other.

none.title: Elektra
none.why: Nikolas is credited (Kurt Max Runte) but the plot's flashbacks centre on young Elektra and her mother's killer; no source describes an on-screen exchange between Elektra and her father. Not shown with evidence, so no stage.

none.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#133
none.why: Running episode 133 is S7 ep 10, Stolen (S1-S6 total 123 episodes), which the tie already has as stage i=1 ("Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#10"). Same episode in another notation; no new stage needed.

owner_calls.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
owner_calls.question: Laura's Logan is dead in this title (Wade digs up his grave; TVA footage shows Laura at his side as he dies). Laura tells the variant Logan that he reminds her of her father and that she got to grow up and have a life because of him. Add a stage for Logan and Laura here, or leave it because he is only remembered?
options: Add family stage: "Logan's death in Laura's arms is shown on the TVA's screens. In the Void, Laura tells another Logan that her father always did the right thing when it mattered, and that she got to grow up because of him." Cards: a about b "His daughter, who still honors him." / b about a "Her late father, who gave her a life."
No stage: he is only mentioned and shown in archive footage
owner_calls.evidence: Deadpool & Wolverine: Paradox explains the death of anchor being Logan (as in Logan); MCU wiki file 'TVA footage of Laura' shows Laura with her father in his final moments; at the campfire Laura tells the variant Logan he reminds her of her father and that she got to grow up and have a life because of him.

owner_calls.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
owner_calls.question: Matt never appears, but Gambit says Daredevil died fighting Cassandra Nova in the Void, Wade offers Elektra his condolences and she says "It's fine." Since a death is a stage, add one here, or leave it because he is only mentioned?
options: Add partner stage: "In the Void, Elektra learns no one survives going up against Cassandra Nova, Daredevil among them. When Wade says he is sorry, she shrugs it off." Cards: a about b "The woman he loved, who outlives him in the Void." / b about a "The man she loved, killed by Cassandra Nova."
No stage: Matt is only mentioned
owner_calls.evidence: Deadpool & Wolverine: Gambit lists Daredevil among those who died going up against Cassandra; Deadpool: "Daredevil? I'm so sorry." Elektra: "It's fine." Ben Affleck's Daredevil was considered but does not appear.

owner_calls.title: Spider-Man 3
owner_calls.question: May learns with Peter from Captain Stacy that Flint Marko, not the first suspect, shot Ben. Ben is dead and appears only in Marko's flashback. Add a stage, or leave it because Ben is only remembered?
options: Add partner stage: "Years after Ben's death, May learns that Flint Marko is the man who really shot him." Cards: a about b "Her late husband, whose real killer is revealed." / b about a "His widow, who learns who really shot him."
No stage: Ben is only mentioned
owner_calls.evidence: Spider-Man 3: Captain Stacy informs Peter and Aunt May that Marko was Ben's true killer; the initial suspect was only his accomplice. (May's widely recalled scene giving Peter Ben's engagement ring could not be confirmed in the sources checked.)
